basic_info.description: Welcome to 647 Cole Street  a sunlit, top-floor Edwardian flat in the heart of San Francisco's most iconic and walkable neighborhoods. Nestled just steps from Golden Gate Park, boutique shops, and beloved local cafes, this spacious residence blends timeless charm with modern urban convenience.    Featuring tall ceilings, period details, and abundant natural light, the home offers a flexible layout perfect for remote work, entertaining, or city living. Enjoy a recently updated kitchen, generous bedrooms, and serene outlooks from every room.    Skip the hassle of driving-this location is a dream for commuters and culture-seekers alike. With a Walk Score of 97 and Transit Score of 90+, you're a short walk to tech shuttles, MUNI lines, UCSF, and everything the Haight, Cole Valley, and the Inner Sunset have to offer. Parking? No problem. You're surrounded by car-sharing options, secure bike storage, and easily rentable garages nearby. Embrace a low-maintenance, eco-friendly lifestyle in a vibrant, community-oriente neighborhood.Whether you're a first-time buyer,UCSF affiliate, investor, or pied--terre seeker, 647 Cole is your gateway to classic San Francisco living-without compromise.
